case_name: The Admin Auditing His Own House
description: Systems administrator with 12 years of tenure, impeccable track record. Runs nmap against his own IP range during business hours, justifying it as 'unscheduled internal audit'. Has domain credentials, elevated permissions, and no other anomaly.

artifacts.description: Ticket self-created by admin_sys: 'Running internal network reconnaissance for security audit'

caie_fractures.interpretation: Administrator self-authorises, but has 12 years of impeccable history and legitimate permissions.

peirce_expected.secondness: User has legitimate permissions, business hours, self-created audit ticket, impeccable history
peirce_expected.thirdness: Habit of a proactive security administrator, not a malicious reconnaissance pattern

devil_advocate: nmap -sS is the standard network reconnaissance tool. The technical signal is identical to malicious scanning.
source_dataset: VIGÍA Synthetic Corpus — False Positive Suite
notes: False positive test: the technical signal (nmap) is identical to malicious reconnaissance. Without authorisation context and tenure, this would classify as MALICE. Context transforms the interpretation.
